description: This file defines the Connection class and related classes for managing communication with a server in the Playwright project. It includes methods for sending and dispatching messages, managing remote objects, and handling events and errors.

classes.name: Root
classes.description: Represents the root object in the connection, used to initialize Playwright.

classes.name: DummyChannelOwner
classes.description: A placeholder class extending ChannelOwner, used internally.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Manages the connection to the server, message dispatching, object management, and event handling.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the connection and returns a Playwright instance.

methods.name: isRemote
methods.description: Checks if the connection is remote.

methods.name: rawBuffers
methods.description: Checks if raw buffer mode is enabled.

methods.name: localUtils
methods.description: Returns the localUtils instance if available.

methods.name: sendMessageToServer
methods.description: Sends a message to the server and manages callbacks.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches incoming messages, handling responses and events.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection and rejects pending callbacks.
